{{recipesummary|category=Recipes for dessert|time=30 minutes|difficulty=2}}
{{recipe|Brownies, Egg White Carrot}} | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Dessert]]

==Ingredients==

* 10 [[Cookbook:Egg White|egg whites]]
* 150 [[Cookbook:Gram|grams]] white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 150 grams [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
* 100 grams [[Cookbook:Dark chocolate|dark cooking chocolate]], melted and cooled slightly
* 100 grams [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], melted and cooled slightly
* 3 [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrots]], [[Cookbook:Grating|grated]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]], [[Cookbook:Zest|zested]]
* 100 grams [[Cookbook:Walnut|walnuts]], [[Cookbook:Mincing|minced]]
* [[Cookbook:Powdered Sugar|Powdered sugar]]

==Procedure==
# [[Cookbook:Whipping|Whip]] the egg whites, gradually adding the sugar, until stiff.
# Stir in the flour and mix well.
# Add the carrots, lemon peel, walnuts, melted chocolate, and melted butter. Mix well.
# Pour the batter into the a greased [[Cookbook:Baking Pan|baking pan]]. Bake at 350°F until cooked through.
# Once cool, cut into pieces and sprinkle with powdered sugar.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Be cautious of overcooking; brownies may be dry if overcooked.
